title: Duke and Chinese food in Boston
summary: Duke would phone ahead and order half the menu at Ruby Foo's after 3 a.m.

blocks.x: We got in to a conversation about Duke's eating habits, and you were telling me about Ruby Fooz in Boston?

Yeah, Ruby Fooz. That was years ago. She used to have a restaurant, which they have one in New York, but they use her name. But that was the real one; they had the door open to the kitchen so that you could see all the Chinamen cooking in there. Whatever you ordered was the real McCoy, and Duke would never order just one dish; he used to call, when they knew him, he used to call to this Chinese place and he would say, 'I'm coming there with maybe 1,2,3, people' and they would have a nice dinner ready for him; he used to order pretty near half the menu on the table. He would never eat just one or two things; because he likes to eat and he loved to eat Chinese food.
You say he used to go there three o'clock in the morning and the place would be packed.
It would be packed in there, and then we'd start eating.
